title: fix(slot): a Slot takes a start point and an exit point
body:
First slice of #3325: the Slot kind. The other kinds of the table stay refused by name.

## What changed

- A Slot takes a start point and an exit point (`PickCapability::Ends`).
- A start pick chooses the slot end where the pass starts. The cutter goes down at that end.
- An exit pick chooses the slot end where the pass stops.
- New planner `machining2d::slot_picked_ends` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_picks.rs`). It returns `(a, b)` or `(b, a)`. It does nothing else.
- The Slot arm of `generate.rs` calls the planner after `slot_extended_ends`, then calls `slot` as before.
- The Slot's Lead in / Lead out tab draws the Start point and Exit point groups. The viewport pick and the viewport marks take the Slot.
- MCP: `edit_operation` sets `picks` on a Slot (the field of #3339). `list_operation_types` answers `start: true, exit: true` for the Slot.

## Cause

`KindInfo::pick()` answered `NotTaken(PICK_OWED)` for the Slot, so `sane.rs` refused each pick. The slot planner did not read a pick.

## Design (where the issue is silent, the smallest change)

- A pick only swaps the two ends. `slot(b, a)` is `slot(a, b)` turned half a turn about the middle of the slot. A half turn keeps the stadium, the rows, the wall lap and the climb sense. No new move shape is made. The test `a_swap_is_the_same_pass_turned_half_a_turn` proves this move by move, arcs included.
- Without a pick the planner returns its input. Each earlier slot is the same to the byte.
- Exit: the row count decides where a pass stops. An odd count stops at the end opposite the start. An even count stops at the end where it started (the wall lap of #2906 closes there). The issue says "the other end" for the exit. That holds for an odd count. For an even count the exit is at the start end, and a pick at the other end is refused by name.
- A start pick and an exit pick together: the start decides. An exit pick at the end where the pass does not stop is refused by name. The refusal gives the two ends and the row count.
- An exit pick alone turns the pass so that it stops at the nearest end.
- Reach: a pick farther from the cutter path than `1.5 x tool diameter + stock to leave` is refused by name. This is the contour's law (`contour_start.rs` `reach`). The cutter path is the stadium of the rows. A pick beside the middle of a long slot is in reach and takes the nearest end.
- A pick the same distance from both ends is refused by name. It names no end.
- A tilted (3+2) slot refuses a pick by name, as the tilted contour does. A pick is a model-frame point.
- The end extensions keep their ends: `extend_start` stays on `a`, `extend_end` on `b`. The #1504 room judges the authored slot as before.
- Entry law, first traverse and the keep-stock check judge the result as before. The start end already changed with the climb flag, so a start at either end is a pass that the generator made before this change.
- `docs/decisions/3325-slot-start-exit.md` has the full record.

## Tests

New test binary reasons:

- `crates/motion/tests/slot_start_exit.rs` groups the Slot end-selection and row-parity laws; no Slot directory suite exists.
- `crates/app/tests/slot_start_exit.rs` groups the Slot command, project-file, MCP, and generation checks; no Slot directory suite exists.

Pins:

- `crates/motion/tests/slot_start_exit.rs` (7 tests, new): `no_pick_is_the_earlier_slot`, `a_swap_is_the_same_pass_turned_half_a_turn`, `the_entry_is_at_the_end_nearest_the_start_pick`, `the_exit_is_at_the_end_nearest_the_exit_pick`, `both_picks_hold_or_the_exit_is_refused_by_name`, `a_pick_that_names_no_end_is_refused_by_name`, `a_slot_that_cannot_be_cut_keeps_its_own_refusal_under_a_pick`. They run one row, three rows and two rows, each with climb and with conventional.
- `crates/app/tests/slot_start_exit.rs` (6 tests, new): capability, entry at the pick, exit at the pick, refusals by name (impossible exit, out of reach, the middle, a tilted slot), command + undo + redo + project file + stamp, MCP `edit_operation` and `list_operation_types`.
- `crates/ui`: `the_slot_lead_tab_has_both_point_groups_and_takes_a_start` (page, Apply, undo) and `a_slot_takes_the_viewport_pick_and_shows_its_marks`.
- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`: the capability list now expects `Ends` for the Slot (an expected change).

Red before the fix: the 6 app tests failed on unchanged `upstream/main` (`ddee3aed6`). Each failed with "Slot: a start point is not taken ..." or with `NotTaken` in place of `Ends`.

Mutations (each one applied, pin run, then restored; all green after the restore):

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `generate.rs` from `upstream/main` (the planner does not read the picks) | RED: 4 app tests |
| the swap removed (`(from, to) = (a, b)`) | RED: 3 motion tests |
| the exit refusal removed | RED: `both_picks_hold_or_the_exit_is_refused_by_name` |
| the reach refusal removed | RED: `a_pick_that_names_no_end_is_refused_by_name` |
| the tie refusal removed | RED: `a_pick_that_names_no_end_is_refused_by_name` |
| the row parity removed (`stops_at_a = !climb`) | RED: 2 motion tests |
| `PathPicks::refusal` not read | RED: `a_pick_that_names_no_end_is_refused_by_name` |
| the tilted slot refusal removed | RED: `a_pick_the_pass_cannot_hold_is_refused_by_name` |

Gates on the final head, against `upstream/main` `ddee3aed6`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` on `82251e67c` (this branch with `upstream/main` `d94b9816d` merged in): 303 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 47.7 min. It ran the `camcraft-ui` lib tests, `example_catalog`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens` and each `slot_*` suite.
- The same quick gate on the head before the merge (`9c08b726f`, base `ddee3aed6`): 303 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `82251e67c`: 106 steps, 1 failed. The failed test is `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`, with the counts `(4688, 4660, 1980)`. Issue #3886 records this test red on main with the same counts. It is a 3D Pocket test. This PR changes only the Slot arm.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` on `c94dbe366`: clean.
- The final head `c94dbe366` adds one commit after the gated head. It collapses a nested `if` for clippy and does not change behaviour. On `c94dbe366` these ran again and passed: motion `slot_start_exit` (7) and `slot_round_ends` (4), app `slot_start_exit` (6), `start_exit_shared` (4), `slot_extension` (5), `example_catalog` (43). The full quick gate and the heavy lanes did not run again on `c94dbe366`.

## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl" examples/catalog` is empty on the final head. `example_catalog`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens` and the slot suites ran and passed without a change. A slot without a pick gets its ends back as they are.

## UI

The Slot page, Lead in / Lead out tab (rendered from the real page code with `egui_kittest`):

| Before (`upstream/main`) | After, both points off | After, a start point set |
|---|---|---|
| ![before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/1eb1d0af49feee812dddf558e48d5905af2f700b/pr-3978/slot-leads-before-off.png) | ![after off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/1eb1d0af49feee812dddf558e48d5905af2f700b/pr-3978/slot-leads-after-off.png) | ![after start set](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/1eb1d0af49feee812dddf558e48d5905af2f700b/pr-3978/slot-leads-after-start-set.png) |

The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch only. The third image shows the gap that "Not exercised" describes.

## Not exercised

- No run on a machine. No simulation of a picked slot against a part model: the swap gives a pass that the generator already made for the other climb sense, and the gouge laws judge it as before.
- Helix and ramp entries with a pick have no pin of their own. The entry certificate is the same stadium for both end orders (the half turn law).
- The Trochoidal Slot, Pocket, 2D Offset, Circular, Trace, Engrave and 2D Chamfer take no pick yet. Each is a later slice of #3325.
- The sentence in the `edit_operation` schema that lists the kinds is not changed. PR #3957 changes the next line, and an edit there makes a merge conflict. `list_operation_types` is the stated source and it names the Slot.
- No row in the `camcraft-mcp` skill (a process file).
- Seen during the screenshots, not changed here: in the `egui_kittest` page harness, a Start point group that is switched on puts its Clear button at the middle of the remaining page height. The rows below it (the consequence line and the Exit point group) are then below the page. The 2D Contour page on `upstream/main` shows the same in the same harness, so this is not from this PR. It is not known if the scrolling pane of the app shows it.

## Overlaps

- #3957 (Wire Contour exit pick) changes other lines of `pick_kinds.rs` (`takes`, the tail of `pick_refusal`) and of `start_exit_shared.rs`. A trial merge of this head with #3957 (`git merge-tree`) is clean.
- #3899, #3832, #3674, #3251, #3103 change other arms of `run_job_arms` in `generate.rs`, not the Slot arm. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #3899, #3251 and #3103 also change `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` or a UI start / exit file. This PR adds two lines to `mod.rs` and no trial merge with those three ran.

Changelog: A Slot takes a start point and an exit point: the pass starts at the slot end nearest the start point and stops at the end nearest the exit point, or the operation is refused by name.

Effort: high

## Review fix round

The Slot yaw transform now rotates temporary start and exit picks with the endpoints.
The stored model coordinates do not change.
The Trochoidal Slot arm keeps its previous transform.

The application pins cover start and exit picks at 90 and 180 degrees.
Each pin also checks a translated work offset and the stored model coordinates.

- `the_start_pick_holds_under_90_degree_wcs_yaw`
- `the_start_pick_holds_under_180_degree_wcs_yaw`
- `the_exit_pick_holds_under_90_degree_wcs_yaw`
- `the_exit_pick_holds_under_180_degree_wcs_yaw`

The two new integration binaries have their required reasons in the Tests section above.
No UI code, recorded program, snapshot, or process file changes in this round.
The UI images above remain applicable.

Pin proof: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test slot_start_exit wcs_yaw -- --nocapture` ran twice.
With the source fix removed, all four yaw pins failed.
At 90 degrees, valid picks were refused as 15 mm from the cutter path, beyond the 9 mm reach.
At 180 degrees, the first descent and exit were at the opposite model endpoints.
After restoration, all four pins passed, including their translated-offset and stored-coordinate checks.

Final source head: `933847f5b8faa90fa93223c13ae1e6e5d22c98eb`.
The gates started against the then-current `upstream/main`: `97a676e5c2307f7a2bc3c7677d1cbe334df8ef40`.
The final fetch advanced `upstream/main` to `10ea81a2a1da2f883d43385757db802e83c99fd1`.
Both upstream heads have the same merge base with this branch: `d94b9816d55043e3a578dea490f6f7d3be31d154`.
I reran both gate plans with `--base upstream/main --dry-run` after that fetch.
The quick plan has the same 303 steps in the same order as the completed run.
The heavy plan has the same 106 steps in the same order as the completed run.
The branch diff and the selected tests did not change. I did not repeat those unchanged tests.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 303 unique steps; 302 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled.
  The first run passed 98 motion steps, then stopped at the application build because rustc could not read compiled dependencies (`E0463`).
  A retry without sccache had the same build error.
  I removed only this worktree's affected package outputs, then rebuilt the application library successfully.
  `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --failed gate-logs/quick-20261125-065237` ran all 205 outstanding steps.
  The recovered run passed 204 steps and failed the UI library; it skipped no planned step.
  The UI library had 1,639 passed, 7 failed, and 8 ignored tests.
  The seven failures match the latest review's upstream baseline failures. The host has no graphics adapter.
  No application or motion test failed after the build output repair.
- The quick gate passed application `slot_start_exit` (10 tests), `example_catalog` (43 passed, 4 ignored),
  `example_catalog_adaptive` (1), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1), `golden_cl` (34), and `solid_law_goldens` (7).
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 106 steps; 105 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 30.2 minutes.
  The failed test is `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.
  It reports `(4688, 4660, 1980)`, the same counts recorded for main in issue #3886 and the earlier PR body.
  This round changes only the Slot yaw transform and its regression tests.
  All other reached heavy steps passed. The gate also checked the marked known failures and got the expected failures.
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed (38.33 seconds).
- `cargo xtask gate light`: all 6 steps passed; 0 failed, 0 stalled. The five test steps passed all 11 light tests.

Goldens moved in this round: none. The catalog and golden suites above ran on the final head without file changes.
The earlier Not exercised section still applies.

Refs #3325
